scope: Admission to begin incorporation only; not revocation during an OS operation
unknown_input: BLOCK_UNKNOWN; no coercion of UNKNOWN to false
authority: ELIGIBLE is a documentary judgment, not execution permission granted by this draft

variable_definitions.task_authorized: Identified task and contemplated incorporation are covered by applicable sufficient authority within the declared scope; may be a replacement incorporation grant after revocation.
variable_definitions.criteria_current_and_pass: All applicable nonempty criteria have current sufficient evidence; no silent exclusion or stale approval.
variable_definitions.base_unchanged: The base bound to the candidate/evidence and destination agree under the required coordination; old hash comparison alone does not establish this.
variable_definitions.resources_admitted: Current resource admission covers this exact operation and its recovery requirements; a historical preflight alone does not establish it.
variable_definitions.process_state_known: Required predecessor termination/cleanup and in-flight write status reconciled; no unresolved blocking execution.
variable_definitions.revoked: At least one applicable revocation was accepted for this task; retained as history/latch, not silently erased by a new grant.
variable_definitions.fresh_incorporation_authorized: A sufficient identified incorporation approval postdates the latest accepted revocation and matches current authority epoch, task,candidate,base and operation; later revocation or invalidated binding makes it false/unknown.

concrete_derivation_status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; truth values require receipt/scope/durability checks, not caller assertion.
